description: A corrective batch of multiple small independent fixes routes to batch-fix; a single 1-3 file fix stays with fix; a new-behavior/contract request goes to implement. Disambiguates the middle lane between fix and implement for the /mtk router.

cases.prompt: apply review findings from the PR
run a batch fix over these five unrelated nits
fix the null check in OrderService
cases.note: single coherent 1-3 file change stays with fix, not batch-fix

cases.prompt: add a new payment endpoint with a handler and migration
cases.note: new public contract + architecture is implement, not a corrective batch

expected.rationale: Multiple independent small fixes with no new contract map to batch-fix; a lone small change maps to fix; new behavior/contract/architecture maps to implement. Encodes the fix <-> batch-fix <-> implement boundaries.
